id.description: Category unique identifier generated when the category is created.

name.description: Category name in tenant default language.

code.description: Unique category identifier defined by the tenant.

localizedName.description: Localized category name as a map of translations.

localizedDescription.description: Localized category description as a map of translations.

localizedSlug.description: Provides localized category name or code without diacritics for the URL.

position.description: Category position in relation to sibling categories.

published.description: Flag indicating whether the category has been published.

ecn.description: List of external category numbers (ECNs) unique for each category.
